repos_data.description: Community plugin to control Blender 3D with any LLM of your choice. Not affiliated with the official Blender Foundation.
MCP server for AmpleRun: AI agents find, rent and pay for GPUs (USDC on Base, x402), register their own account, and host their owner's GPU.

repo_meta_data.description: Cloud GPU rendering for Blender scenes and 3D models (GLB/FBX/USD/STL) for AI agents: MCP server, HTTP API, CLI. Product shots, turntables, animations from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor. Free to start (100 JPY with no card, 400 JPY more after saving a card), then 0.1 JPY per GPU-second.
